scope: Resolution workspace, guide-agent service and verified volunteer workflow
newBrowserCasesResult: 27 passed: Chromium 9, Firefox 9, WebKit 9; the same local run also passed 15 judge-walkthrough cases.
localRegressionEvidence: The first expanded CI runs each passed 147 of 149 browser cases. They exposed one obsolete help-copy assertion and intermittent WebKit form input interrupted by deferred route focus. Follow-up fixes update the assertion, complete focus before interaction and add explicit input-retention checks. The latest complete suite runs in GitHub CI on push.
deploymentConfiguration: Vercel had no environment variables at inspection; COMMUNITY_ENABLED and LIVE_COACH_ENABLED default off.
liveInference: not performed; transport and tool-loop tests use fixtures
hostedDatabase: not provisioned; migration and access rules tested in PostgreSQL via PGlite
remainingActivation: OpenAI project key, evaluated model and operating budget
Independent language, practitioner and participant reviews
deploymentRegression: Reproduced and fixed Node ESM imports pointing at TypeScript source paths after deployment. A test emits the function dependency graph and starts both endpoints in plain Node without a TypeScript loader. Production GET /api/community returns 200 and POST /api/coach returns the expected unconfigured 503 after the fix.
inPageNavigationRegression: Production testing found that native fragment links could discard a guide's opaque in-memory route. In-page links now scroll and move keyboard focus without adding a history entry. A regression checks assistant and skip links, guide progress and browser Back in all three engines.
focusRegression: CI WebKit traces showed text absent immediately after an automated fill while delayed route focus scrolled the page. Route focus now completes in a layout effect before interaction. File and walkthrough tests check entered values before continuing, in addition to their round-trip assertions.
